Resume late Cursor ceiling cancellation

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-18
  description: |-
    Preserve pending resource-ceiling reconciliation when Cursor cancellation finishes after the controller timeout. Recovery now re-enters exact session load, rearms the lease, and dispatches one continuation instead of terminalizing the cancellation event.
    
    Extend the bounded cancellation race to recover the late Cursor session and assert a running disposition with one exact continuation.
